user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain the polygon boundary needed to identify census tracts intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked registered dataset representing the State College borough boundary. The returned artifact must be a polygon dataset suitable for spatial overlay with the supplied census tracts.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Prepare the retrieved borough boundary for compatible spatial overlay with the supplied census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:26918. Do not guess the source CRS; require the retrieved artifact metadata to identify it explicitly before transformation.

workflow_steps.title: Intersect census tracts with State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the census tract zones that intersect the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersection overlay between the supplied census tract polygons and the projected State College borough boundary. Preserve tract identifiers and produce a GeoPackage polygon layer containing the intersecting tract zones.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject elevation raster to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Align the elevation raster with the intersecting tract zones for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the supplied DEM GeoTIFF to EPSG:26918, preserving elevation values and producing a GeoTIFF suitable for zonal statistics with the tract zones.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean elevation by intersecting tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Summarize mean elevation from the DEM for each census tract zone intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal statistics using the projected DEM and the intersecting tract zones. Return the mean elevation for each tract zone, retaining the tract identifier fields in the CSV summary.
